tax.text: Ramirez argues the tax code favors the wealthy over working families and backs progressive taxation to fund social programs.
tax.quote: Ramirez believes our tax code shouldn't do more for billionaires and corporations than it does for working families.

wages.text: Ramirez says jobs must pay a living wage and protect the right to organize, and co-sponsored raising the federal minimum wage and the PRO Act.
wages.quote: must pay a living wage, provide strong benefits, and protect a worker's right to organize for fair pay and good working conditions

debt.text: She opposes cuts or work requirements for Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid and other safety-net programs.
debt.quote: continues to oppose efforts to make cuts or create work requirements for SNAP, TANF, Medicare, Medicaid, and other social programs

housing.text: She describes herself as a champion for building more housing, especially affordable and family housing.
housing.quote: She is a champion for building more housing - especially affordable housing and housing for families

schools.text: Ramirez advocates for well-resourced neighborhood public schools and more federal funding for them.
schools.quote: additional federal resources so that communities can stop relying on property taxes and every neighborhood has strong schools

safety.text: She emphasizes addressing root causes of crime through restorative justice, violence prevention and community programs.
safety.quote: expanding restorative justice programs in our schools and community centers

immigration.text: She backs comprehensive reform creating legal pathways to citizenship and keeping families together.
immigration.quote: create legal pathways to citizenship, keep families together, and help our communities and local economies thrive

guns.text: She supports universal background checks, an assault-weapons ban and curbing illegal gun trafficking.
guns.quote: universal background checks, banning assault-style weapons, and reducing the flow of illegal guns

abortion.text: Ramirez calls herself an uncompromising supporter of reproductive rights and abortion access.
abortion.quote: people everywhere must have autonomy over their own bodies and pathways to economic security

gender.text: She backs nondiscrimination protections and the Equality Act covering gender identity.
gender.quote: live free from discrimination and harassment because of their sexual orientation or gender identity

health.text: She supports Medicare for All and a single-payer system guaranteeing universal coverage.
health.quote: getting health care costs down, including supporting Medicare for All

energy.text: She calls for swift climate action and co-sponsored the Green New Deal.
energy.quote: we are at a crisis point to act on climate change and that we need swift and decisive action to prevent a climate catastrophe

voting.text: She supports expanding voting access, same-day registration and vote-by-mail.
voting.quote: a strong democracy requires an engaged and informed electorate and policies that protect and expand voting rights

tax.text: On her campaign website she describes herself as a fiscal conservative who favors a free-market economy that keeps taxes low.
tax.quote: Angel is a fiscal conservative who believes true prosperity comes from a free-market economy that empowers small businesses and keeps taxes low.

debt.text: Her platform pledges to uphold Social Security and Medicare obligations while also developing what she calls sustainable reforms for both.
debt.quote: Uphold Social Security and Medicare obligations, while developing sustainable reforms for both.

immigration.text: Her campaign policy platform calls for strengthening border security to stop cartels, trafficking, and illegal entry.
immigration.quote: Strengthening border security to stop cartels, trafficking, and illegal entry

health.text: Her health care platform calls for expanding choice and competition among doctors, hospitals, insurers, and pharmacies.
health.quote: Expand choice and competition among doctors, hospitals, insurers, pharmacies

voting.text: Oakley's platform supports a national voter ID standard with free, accessible verification.
voting.quote: A clear national standard for voter ID with free, accessible verification
